translation.englishName: Urim: Wurkapm a Maur Wailen Portions

book.name: Pilipai
book.title: Wurkapm a Pol ro kai ekg tu Pilipai

content: Mento alupm nikgwalpm wrij aklin tita

Ak wang a ake kipm titnongket pa, Krais pa akepm titnongket aki? Kil ukpma wor wakrongentepm, tolpa om ak ntekg ipma akipm pa arpm mehen wor aki? Yatom Maur Wor kil pa wiyepm ye kai hor wrij, tolpa om kipm nikgwalpm wor rein tita lokli tita aki?
Ti kupm la nasepm titnongket la tolpa, al kipm alupm nikgwalpm wrij, kipm plalnten ukpma wor wakrongen tita, wa kipm irk hor wrij kor tita. Kipm ak tolpa pa, kupm utopen wailmanten paitn ekg kipm.

Ampur kipm akwonalmpen kipm alkipm ti tolti, yatom kipm ntekg kweiur kweiur pa ekg kipm akal wi nang wail hangken tu tiur ai, tolpa yaper. Kipm rku kipm alkipm ti ye nar horhanekg ekg mla ur ai, kipm kit nang a tu pa, la tolpa tu pa wor pake.
Kipm wrij wrij atning ari kuina ur a tu tiur manet wakrongen pa, yatom kipm iklin tu pa hep pen. Ampur kipm akwonalmpen kipm alkipm pa akal aklin kipm alkipm ti hute, pa kalpm.
Krais kil arku kil alkil yatom Maur Wailen kil kat nang akil
Nikgwalpm a kipm pa, apm kipm alupm nikgwalpm tol a Krais Jisas alkil pake:
Krais kil alkil apm hirhir tol Maur Wailen pake, ari kil ake wa akal nampil nang wail alkil pa atn pa atn.
Kil nuhurn nang wail alkil a hirhir tol Maur Wailen pa. Wa kil paln tol melnum a ak kwap kalpmel horhanekg ekg melnum ur tolti. Kil pike man rakuel paln melnum tol mento tike.
Kil arku kil alkil atning nungkulkg hor hanekg ekg Maur Wailen. Kil atning nungkulkg tolpa kaingkai, tu karkurntel kai yo kwatingki pa om kil mo.
Kil arku kil alkil tolpa yatom, Maur Wailen wiyel ye kaino ukwel nang wail a atn hep hangken nang wrongwailet.
Kil uk nang ripa ekg Jisas, ekg kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a atn kaino ktnong pa, a atn hor knokg ti, a ark kinar knokg wonen pa, tu hi eln nar kpor klko leinjel, horhanekg ekg kil wrij hute.
Hi wa tu wrongwailet a ark hor pa laron nang a Jisas Krais ti la tolpa, kil pa Melnum Wailen a atn hep, yatom ak kat nang a Maur Wailen, Yan Wailen pa.
Wakg a ak helen tu wrong kinkpman

Tolpa ti kipm melnum wokgen yikek alkupm, aklei wang kipm atning nungkulkg ak wang a pike kupm ntiepm arpm kai pa. Pake wailmanten pa pati, kipm itning nungkulkg ik wang ti a kupm ake ntiepm arpm. Tolpa ti kipm kirk kwarkwar kai ikg a Maur Wailen pa, ukpma Jisas titnongket tolpa ye kai, ekg nte kil apm pike aklin akwiyepm ase.
Pa ekg nte Maur Wailen kil alkil pa kil yiprokgen, yatom kil ntekg kipm utopen ekg atning nungkulkg, wa ukwepm titnongket pa, yatom kipm ak kwap katnun nikgwalpm wakrongen a kil wrij hute.
Kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a kipm akal ntekg pa pati, ampur kipm ekla wailet ak kiti ekel tita ekg yangkipmek tiur pa, yaper.

Ekg ake al melnum ur lawepm tolpa, kipm pa melnum a ntekg paitnpaitn pa, kalpm. Kipm arpm hrukij wri wor tol warim wor a Maur Wailen. Kipm arpm knokg mningket a tu melnum a ntekg paitnpaitn arke, yatom nuhurn ya nipet, wa ngkom hor ya raimpen pa. Al kipm ye yangkipm a Maur Wailen a arpm aklei wang pa laron ak aklin tu pa ekg tu atning katnun pa, om hi wa tu arpm wor aklei wang. Kipm pa tol wakg a ak helen ya ekg tu pa ngkom hore. Tol kipm ak katnun ye tolpa kai pa, kupm hi wa utopentepm paitn tpra ak wang a Krais kil wa nar pa, pa ak plan tolpa kwap wail a pike kupm ntekg ekg aklin kipm pa, ake kupm ak kalpmel.

Pike kipm ukpma Maur Wailen tol kipm al wor uk kipm alkipm kai ekg Maur Wailen. Tol tu ntekg akal almpopm ur pa, kupm utopen. Tol walmpopm akupm ti ungkwan ekg ak kaluk kipm pa namponen al wor uk a kipm alkipm ti kai ekg Maur Wailen ti pa, kupm hi wa utopentepm yat.
Tolpa ti kipm apm wa tolpa yat pake. Kipm utopen namponentopm pa, tol kupm wa utopen ntiepm yat!
Pol akal kwa Timoti kai ari tu Pilipai

Kupm akwonalmpen tolpa, wakrong a Wailen Jisas ti pa, kupm akal kwa Timoti kil ak ketn ur ti kai atn ariepm atning ariepm tolpa kipm ark tolhai, plaln pa, wa kil kul la nasopm tolpa kipm ark wor pa, ipma a kupm pa kulkula wor om.
Ake kupm ari melnum ur a nikgwalpm ark ekg kipm pa tol kupm ti pa, kalpm. Kupm ari tol Timoti wrij hute tolti kil nikgwalpm ark ekg kipm pake.
Ari tol wrongwailet ti nikgwalpm rein akwonalmpen kuina ur a tu alntu ti tolti. Ake tu nikgwalpm rein kwap a Jisas Krais ti.
Pake kipm apm ari Timoti pa kil melnum wor a atn titnongket ye kalkut. Kil apm pike nti kupm ti atn tukol warim alkupmen pake, om kil aklinjopm ekg mentekg ak kwap ekg yangkipm wor a Krais.
Ti kupm akal hi kwa Timoti kil alkil pa kai ariepm pake. Ari kupm akal atn nungkwangen yangkipm alkupmen kil pen, tu ntekg yangkipm akupm kil kai tolhai plaln pa, kupm kwawel kai pake.
Ti kupm alkupm ti yat, kupm ari tolpa Wailen hi aklinjopm pa, ti kupm arpm nungkwangen tolpa kupm hi wa ak ketn ur ti katnuntel kai ariepm pake.
Pol akal kwa Epaprotitus kai ari tu Pilipai

Kupm wa akwonalmpen yat tolpa hi kupm kwa Epaprotitus ti wa kaintepm. Melnum yek pa pike kipm kwawel kul tol melnum yangkipm kuinen alkipmen yatom kil aklinjopm ekg kwap hlaikip wrongwailet. Kil pa tukol wasok alkupmen, kil pike ntiopm ak kwap wrij. Mentekg yaten pike ye kalkut ekg talpuln tu a la paitnel yangkipm a Maur Wailen pa.
Pike tu ur la nasepm tolpa kil ti numpet paitn, yatom kipm ipma kalkut ekg kil. Kil atning pa, yatom kil nikgwalpm ark ekg kipm paitn tolpa kil akal kai ariepm, ti kupm akal kwawel kai pake.

Ei, aklahle, kil apm pike wi numpet wail akal tol mo pake. Ari apm pike Maur Wailen kil alkil pa akmekgel reinjel yatom aklinjel, ti kil paln wor arpm pa. Ake kil rein kil wrij pa, kalpm, wa kil wa rein kupm ti yat, tolpa ekg ake wa ye kalkut ur pa wa ye kul ak arkuopm hangken kalkut a kupm ye kil pa, kalpm.
Tolpa ti kupm wakrongen paitn ekg al kwawel kai pake. Ak wang a kil kai palntepm pa, kipm utopentel om! Tolpa ekg hi wa ntekg ipma alkupmen ti wa kai kulkula ketnketn.
Kipm ukwel wor utopentel tol kil melnum ur a ukpma Wailen. Kipm wiyel tol melnum ur a nang itne,

ekg nte melnum yek pike uk num alkilen ti kai ekg ak kwap a Krais, kil wi numpet wail akal mo akarmpen kwap a kil pa. Kil ari tolpa kipm pa arpm watinet, ake ntie ekg al kipm kul aklinjopm, tolpa yatom kil ti wi wrik a kipm pa kul aklinjopm tike.

footnotes.text: 2.17 Tu Juta akal lap wlikgek ti ekg al wor uk kai ekg Maur Wailen pa, tu apm alung hu wain pa ak itne wlikgek pa hep, plaln pa, tu lap.
